Agent 05/35 — countersteer recovery release/snap-back. Test the full digital oversteer catch from onset through recovery and steering release. Look for abrupt authority collapse, oscillation or snap as yaw/sideslip cross recovery thresholds. Evaluate whether recovery needs hysteresis/state memory or smoother blend decay. Do not add yaw damping, ESC, grip or hidden corrective forces. Preserve analog behavior. Require left/right mirrors, induced oversteer diagnostic, transient tests and strict validation.
